name: MaslBound — COD Manager for WooCommerce
author: victan

sections.description:
MaslBound is a COD order operations & risk-control suite — not a shipping-rate or carrier plugin. It solves the hardest part of Cash on Delivery: proving the order is real before you pay to ship it, then showing your return (RTO) rate at a glance.

Other plugins quote checkout shipping rates or connect carriers. MaslBound does the part they skip — confirm the buyer, reduce failed deliveries, and surface the COD analytics that actually move your margin. It runs on top of any shipping plugin you already use.

Before you ship, MaslBound Pro sends a WhatsApp message with Confirm/Cancel buttons. One tap to confirm. No reply within 24h? Flagged as suspicious for manual review.

What MaslBound is (and isn’t)

  • Is: A COD risk-control layer — order confirmation, 10-status tracking, RTO analytics, multi-channel alerts.
  • Isn’t: A shipping-rate quoter or carrier aggregator. It does not replace your shipping plugin; it manages the COD order lifecycle on top of it.

Features

Pre-Ship WhatsApp Confirmation (Pro)
Automatically verify COD orders via WhatsApp before shipping. Customers confirm with one tap. Unconfirmed orders are flagged for review.

10-Status COD Order Tracking
Track every COD order through 10 custom statuses beyond WooCommerce’s basic “processing / completed”:
– Pending Confirmation — order placed, awaiting customer confirmation
– Flagged Suspicious — no confirmation within timeout, needs review
– Confirmed — customer confirmed, ready to ship
– Processing — being prepared
– Shipped — handed to carrier
– Out for Delivery — on the delivery route
– Delivery Attempted — first delivery attempt failed
– Delivered — signed and received
– Returned — returned to origin (RTO)
– Cancelled — cancelled by customer or admin

COD Fee Rules
Add COD handling fees based on country, cart total, shipping method, or user role. Three fee types: fixed, percentage, or fixed+percentage.

Analytics Dashboard
View COD order statistics: total orders, confirmation rates, delivery success rates, RTO rates, and fee revenue — updated in real-time without cron delays.

Multi-Channel Notifications
Email, Web Push, and WhatsApp (Twilio) notifications for every status change. The “Out for Delivery” notification reminds customers to prepare cash. WhatsApp Order Confirmation and Meta Cloud API are available in Pro.

Carrier Integration
17TRACK API integration for universal tracking. Speedaf plugin bridge (zero-invasion). J&T Express and Speedaf pre-configured.

Southeast Asia Support
Built for ID, TH, VN, MY, PH markets. Multi-currency fees, local phone number formatting, and 10-language support (Vietnamese, Thai, Indonesian, Malay, Arabic, Khmer, Lao, Burmese, Filipino, Chinese).

How WhatsApp Confirmation Works (Pro)

  1. Customer places a COD order → Status: Pending Confirmation
  2. MaslBound sends a WhatsApp message with “Confirm” / “Cancel” buttons
  3. Customer taps Confirm → Status: Confirmed → Ready to ship
  4. Customer taps Cancel → Status: Cancelled
  5. No reply within 24 hours → Status: Flagged Suspicious → Manual review

Supported Carriers

  • J&T Express — ID, MY, PH, TH, VN (via 17TRACK)
  • Speedaf — Direct plugin bridge, zero-invasion
  • Any carrier — Via 17TRACK universal tracking API

WhatsApp Provider Options

  • Twilio (Free & Pro) — Pay-per-use. No business verification needed. Quick setup with Sandbox.
  • Meta Cloud API (Pro only) — Direct from Meta. No monthly fee. Requires business verification.

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later.

External Services

This plugin optionally connects to third-party services for messaging and tracking functionality. These services are not required for the plugin to function — they are only used when you explicitly configure them in the plugin settings.

Twilio (WhatsApp Messaging)

When you configure a Twilio Account SID and Auth Token in the plugin settings, the plugin sends WhatsApp messages via the Twilio API.

  • What data is sent: The recipient’s phone number, message body, and your Twilio credentials (SID and Auth Token stored in your WordPress database).
  • When it is sent: When a COD order status changes and WhatsApp notifications are enabled.
  • Terms of Service: https://www.twilio.com/legal/tos
  • Privacy Policy: https://www.twilio.com/legal/privacy

17TRACK (Shipment Tracking)

When you configure a 17TRACK API key in the plugin settings, the plugin sends tracking numbers to the 17TRACK API to retrieve shipment status updates.

  • What data is sent: Tracking numbers and carrier codes for orders you choose to track.
  • When it is sent: When tracking information is requested for an order, or when the scheduled tracking sync runs.
  • Terms of Service: https://www.17track.net/en/about/licensing
  • Privacy Policy: https://www.17track.net/en/about/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the maslbound-cod-manager-for-woocommerce folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu
  3. Navigate to MaslBound → Settings to configure
  4. (Optional) Enter your Pro license key to unlock WhatsApp Confirmation
sections.faq:
How does WhatsApp Confirmation work?

Before shipping, MaslBound Pro sends a WhatsApp message asking the customer to confirm their order. If they don’t respond within 24 hours, the order is flagged as suspicious. You can then decide whether to ship.

Is WhatsApp Confirmation free?

WhatsApp Confirmation is a Pro feature. The WhatsApp API charges per conversation (~$0.005-0.01), but each 24-hour conversation window covers unlimited messages. Meta Cloud API has no monthly fee; Twilio is pay-per-use.

What’s the difference between Meta Cloud API and Twilio?

Meta Cloud API: Direct from Meta, no monthly fee. Requires business verification.
Twilio: Pay-per-use, no business verification needed, instant setup with Sandbox.

Does this work with HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage)?

Yes. MaslBound is HPOS-compatible and declares compatibility to WooCommerce.

Does this work with Block Checkout (Store API)?

Yes. Both classic checkout and Block Checkout are supported.

Does this work with the Speedaf plugin?

Yes. MaslBound bridges with the Speedaf plugin without modifying any of its code. Speedaf tracking updates sync to MaslBound’s COD status system.

Is MaslBound a shipping or carrier plugin?

No. MaslBound does not quote checkout shipping rates and does not replace a carrier/shipping plugin. It manages the COD order lifecycle — confirmation, 10-status tracking, RTO analytics, and notifications — and runs on top of whatever shipping setup you already use. Think of it as the “COD risk-control layer” for your store.

What countries are supported?

All countries, with optimizations for Southeast Asia: Indonesia (ID), Thailand (TH), Vietnam (VN), Malaysia (MY), Philippines (PH). Phone number auto-formatting for local number formats.

Can customers track their orders?

Yes. Add the [maslbound_tracking] shortcode to any page. Customers enter their tracking number and see a step-by-step timeline with carrier details.
